def run_restart(log) -> None:
    cmd = [hermes_bin(), "-p", "default", "gateway", "restart"]
    log("restart", f"running {shlex.join(cmd)} (CLI wait budget bounded; Hermes owns interruption and resume_pending)")
    # Do NOT add --force here: on `gateway restart` it means "start a separate gateway", not "override a guard".
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=RESTART_TIMEOUT_SECONDS,
                           env=dict(os.environ, GATEWAY_COORDINATED_RESTART='1', HERMES_RESTART_AFTER_TURN_TIMEOUT='1', HERMES_RESTART_DRAIN_TIMEOUT='1'))
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        raise Fail(f"`hermes gateway restart` ran longer than {RESTART_TIMEOUT_SECONDS}s. State: gateway may be down or "
                   f"still draining; drain marker will be cleared. Fix: `hermes -p default gateway status`, then "
                   f"`python3 {SCRIPT} request --reason \"retry\"`.")
    tail = (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-6:]
    for line in tail:
        log("restart", f"hermes: {line}")
    if r.returncode != 0 and "Restart budget blocked" in (r.stdout + r.stderr) and \
            bool(((load_state() or {}).get("request") or {}).get("force")):
        # 7 Oct 2026: Hermes allows one intentional restart per hour. This request was made with --force and the
        # gateway is already drained and idle, so restart through the service manager (what `hermes update` does).
        # Without this, an urgent rollback within the hour is blocked.
        if sys.platform == "darwin":
            svc = [["launchctl", "kickstart", "-k", f"gui/{os.getuid()}/ai.hermes.gateway"]]
        else:
            svc = [["systemctl", "--user", "reset-failed", "hermes-gateway.service"],
                   ["systemctl", "--user", "restart", "hermes-gateway.service"]]
        for c in svc:
            log("restart", f"Hermes restart budget is spent and this request is --force: running {shlex.join(c)}")
            r = subprocess.run(c, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=RESTART_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)
        for line in (r.stdout + r.stderr).strip().splitlines()[-4:]:
            log("restart", f"service manager: {line}")
    if r.returncode != 0:
        guard = ("  TurnerBook has a local guard that refuses a second restart within 60 minutes unless hermes is given "
                 "--force; wait it out (do not use --force here: on this command it starts a SEPARATE gateway). "
                 if sys.platform == "darwin" else "")
        raise Fail(f"`hermes gateway restart` exited {r.returncode}.{guard} State: gateway is whatever hermes left it "
                   f"(check `hermes -p default gateway status`); drain marker cleared so bots can work. Fix: read the "
                   f"hermes lines above, fix, then `python3 {SCRIPT} request --reason \"retry after failed restart\"`.")

log("pause", "would acquire owned ESTOP and every board dispatch lock; existing pause aborts safely")
    else:
        pause.acquire()
        # Publish before lock acquisition so a slow in-flight tick consumes the deadline.
        req["deadline_minutes"], req["deadline_at"] = publish_initial_deadline(rid, req["deadline_minutes"])
        pause.barrier(req["deadline_at"])

    # (a) drain marker
    foreign = read_marker()
    owns_marker = True
    if foreign and not str(foreign.get("principal", "")).startswith("coordinated-restart:"):
        owns_marker = False
        log("drain", f"a drain marker from {foreign.get('principal')!r} already exists; leaving it alone (we will not "
                     f"clear it). Remove it with: rm {DRAIN_MARKER}", loud=True)
    elif dry:
        log("drain", f"would write {DRAIN_MARKER}: {json.dumps(drain_marker_payload(principal, boot_epoch()))}")
    else:
        write_marker(principal)
        log("drain", f"wrote {DRAIN_MARKER}; gateway now refuses NEW turns, running turns continue")

key = None if dry else api_key()
        notified = notified_profiles(work)  # kept for step (j); see notified_profiles

        if dry:
            deadline_at = now() + req["deadline_minutes"] * 60
        else:   # one critical section: a joiner's shorter minutes cannot fall between the read and the write
            deadline_at = req["deadline_at"]
        req["deadline_at"] = deadline_at

        if is_idle(work):
            # (c)
            log("idle", "nobody is working: going straight to the restart")
        else:
            # (d)
            log("evaluate", restart_wait_guidance(), loud=True)
            send_notices(work, req, gs, key, log, dry)

st["request"]["status"] = "restarting"
            save_state(st)
        snap = collect_snapshot(False, lambda *a, **k: None)
        gs = snap["gateway_state"] or {}
        pre = {"pid": gateway_pid(gs), "served": gs.get("served_profiles") or [],
               "platforms": [p for p, v in (gs.get("platforms") or {}).items() if v.get("state") == "connected"]}
        interrupted, cards = cut_sets(who_is_working(snap))
        stragglers = describe_work(who_is_working(snap))
        with locked(STATE_LOCK):
            st = load_state()
            st["last_restart_at"] = now()
            save_state(st)
        pause.check()
        # Last fresh read, including workers finishing after their card was closed.
        confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log)
        run_restart(log)

        # (h) clear marker immediately (it survives a gateway-only restart)
        if owns_marker:
            clear_own_marker(principal)
            log("drain", "drain marker cleared")
            owns_marker = False

        # (i) verify
        update_request(rid, status="verifying")
        ok, problems = verify(pre, log)

log("resume", f"{p}: card {tid} -> {kanban_comment(tid, text)}")
        if interrupted:
            log("resume", "interrupted chat sessions are also resumed by Hermes itself (resume_pending); a bot that "
                          "checkpointed reads its Session-notes entry per the gateway-restart-checkpoint skill")
        wake_bots(wake_profiles(interrupted, cards, notified), req, wake_cmd, log, False)

        # (k) outcome
        status = "done" if ok and not stragglers else "done_with_warnings"
        outcome = (f"Restart {rid} finished {iso()}: gateway " + ("healthy." if ok else "NOT fully healthy: " +
                   "; ".join(problems) + f". Fix: hermes -p default gateway status; logs in {HERMES_HOME}/logs/.") +
                   (" Interrupted while working: " + " | ".join(stragglers) if stragglers else " Nobody was cut off."))
        update_request(rid, status=status, outcome=outcome, step="finished")
        atomic_write(OUTCOME_FILE, outcome + "\n")
        log("outcome", outcome, loud=not ok or bool(stragglers))
        if req.get("notify_cmd"):
            try:
                r = subprocess.run([*shlex.split(req["notify_cmd"]), outcome], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
                log("outcome", f"sent to requester via notify-cmd (exit {r.returncode})")
            except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as e:
                log("outcome", f"notify-cmd failed ({e}); the outcome is in {OUTCOME_FILE}", loud=True)
        else:
            log("outcome", f"no --notify-cmd route; requester reads it with `status` or {OUTCOME_FILE}")
    finally:

check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        update_request(rid, status='restarting', switch_cmd=req.get('switch_cmd'))
        run_retained_callback(req, log)
        acquire_auxiliary_best_effort(req, log)
        pause.check()
        check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log)
        gs = read_gateway_state() or {}
        pre = {'pid': gateway_pid(gs), 'served': gs.get('served_profiles') or [],
               'platforms': [p for p, v in (gs.get('platforms') or {}).items() if v.get('state') == 'connected']}
        run_restart(log)
        update_request(rid, status='verifying')
        ok, problems = verify(pre, log)
        if not ok:
            raise Fail('Gateway health failed; pause retained: ' + '; '.join(problems))
        check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        acquire_auxiliary_best_effort(req, log)
        update_request(rid, status='done', health_ok=True, outcome='Healthy. All pauses retained until explicit release.')

def common(sp, needs_reason):
        sp.add_argument("--reason", required=needs_reason, help="why a restart is needed (recorded and shown in status)")
        sp.add_argument("--by", help="who is asking (default: $HERMES_PROFILE, else $USER)")
        sp.add_argument("--deadline-minutes", type=float, default=DEFAULT_DEADLINE_MINUTES,
                        help=f"how long working bots get to checkpoint (default {DEFAULT_DEADLINE_MINUTES})")
        sp.add_argument("--min-gap-minutes", type=float, default=MIN_GAP_MINUTES,
                        help=f"minimum time between restarts (default {MIN_GAP_MINUTES})")
        sp.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="skip the minimum gap (needs --reason; it is recorded)")
        sp.add_argument("--notify-cmd", help="command that sends the outcome to the requester; the outcome text is "
                                             "appended as its last argument, e.g. \"hermes peer dm local/max-cndr\"")
        sp.add_argument("--wake-cmd", help="command that wakes one bot after the restart (default: hermes -p <bot> chat "
                                           "--in ~ -c \"Bot Chat\" --create-if-missing -Q -q <text>). {profile} and "
                                           "{text} are filled in; with no {text} the text is added as the last argument. "
                                           "Run once per cut bot, 60 s at most each. \"none\" turns it off")
        sp.add_argument("--switch-cmd", help="command run once after the gateway is idle and before it restarts, e.g. to switch "
                                             "the Hermes checkout (`git -C <checkout> checkout -B <branch> <ref>`). Split "
                                             "like --notify-cmd, no shell; 600 s limit; make it safe to run twice. A "
                                             "non-zero exit stops the restart (status failed, step FAILED: switch-cmd)")
        sp.add_argument("--retain-pause", action="store_true", help="retain all pauses until explicit successful release")
        sp.add_argument("--resume-request", help="recover this exact retained request after its processes exit")
        sp.add_argument("--switch-timeout", type=float, default=600, help="callback budget in seconds; must exceed the sum of recipe budgets")
        sp.add_argument("--auxiliary-plan", help="service fence plan JSON; defaults to state directory auxiliary-plan.json")
        sp.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="do every read, print what would happen, change nothing")

def new_request_record(args, by: str, gap_wait: float) -> dict:
    t = now()
    return {"id": time.strftime("r-%Y%m%d-%H%M%S-", time.localtime(t)) + uuid.uuid4().hex[:4], "status": "requested",
            "reason": args.reason, "by": by, "host": socket.gethostname(), "requested_at": t,
            "deadline_minutes": min(10.0, args.deadline_minutes), "deadline_at": None,
            "not_before": t + gap_wait if gap_wait > 0 and not args.force else None,
            "force": bool(args.force), "notify_cmd": getattr(args, "notify_cmd", None),
            "wake_cmd": getattr(args, "wake_cmd", None), "switch_cmd": getattr(args, "switch_cmd", None),
            "retain_pause": bool(getattr(args, "retain_pause", False)),
            "switch_timeout": min(600, getattr(args, "switch_timeout", 600)),
            "auxiliary_plan": getattr(args, "auxiliary_plan", None),
            "joiners": [],
            "waiting_for": [], "step": "recorded", "steps": [], "outcome": None, "cancel_requested": False}

def request_plan_text(rec: dict, args) -> str:
    when = (f"after the minimum gap, at about {hhmm(rec['not_before'])}" if rec["not_before"] else "now")
    return (f"Request {rec['id']}: this machine's gateway will refuse new work {when}, working bots will be asked to "
            f"checkpoint and stop (up to {rec['deadline_minutes']} min). At the deadline, checkpoint notices are posted and the gateway restarts; bots "
            f"resume. Status: python3 {SCRIPT} status")

def confirm_idle_for_switch(log) -> None:
    """Before step (f2): a FRESH look at the machine (not the wait loop's last reading) must show the gateway idle
    (its own activity count read and zero, and nobody named as working), or stopped with no Kanban worker running.
    Unknown activity is neither: it is refused unless the gateway process is shown stopped (SwitchDeferredUnknown).
    Otherwise raise SwitchDeferred, so the checkout is never switched under a running turn. The drain marker is still ours here, so no NEW turn can start between this look and the switch.
    A fresh idle check is required for both ordinary restarts and switches. Hermes can resume a cut turn on
    the same code; a switch changes the code under the turn, and the restart would then not carry it out safely."""
    snap = collect_snapshot(False, lambda *a, **k: None)
    if snap.get("kanban_running") is None:
        log("evaluate", restart_wait_guidance(), loud=True)
        # Fail closed. Kanban workers are separate processes the gateway does not count, so an unreadable list
        # means "unknown", never "idle" (the old code let the switch run here; found by the outside verifier).
        raise SwitchDeferredUnreadable(
            "--switch-cmd was NOT run: the Kanban worker list could not be read (the `hermes kanban list --status "
            "running --json` command failed, timed out, or printed something that is not a list), so nobody can say "
            "whether a worker is running under the checkout. State: nothing was switched and the gateway was NOT "
            "restarted; the drain marker is cleared so bots can work. Fix: run `hermes kanban list --status running "
            f"--json` by hand and read its error, then `python3 {SCRIPT} request` again once it prints a list.")
    work = who_is_working(snap)
    gs = snap.get("gateway_state")
    if not isinstance(gs, dict):
        gs = None
    known = gateway_activity_known(gs)
    if known and is_idle(work):
        log("switch", "fresh check before the switch: everyone is idle")
        return
    # Independent evidence that the gateway is stopped: process checks, not one state file (see
    # gateway_stopped_evidence). Then no gateway turn runs, so only Kanban workers could be left.
    stopped, why = gateway_stopped_evidence(gs)
    if stopped and snap.get("kanban_running") == []:
        log("switch", f"fresh check before the switch: gateway is stopped ({why}) and no Kanban worker is running")
        return
    if not known and is_idle(work):
        log("evaluate", restart_wait_guidance(), loud=True)
        # Nothing names a worker, but the gateway was never asked either: unreadable state is "unknown", never "idle".
        raise SwitchDeferredUnknown(
            "--switch-cmd was NOT run: the gateway's activity could not be read (gateway_state.json is missing, "
            "unreadable or has no active_agents count) and no check shows the gateway process stopped, so nobody can "
            "say whether a turn runs under the checkout. State: nothing was switched and the gateway was NOT "
            "restarted; the drain marker is cleared so bots can work. Fix: check the gateway "
            "(`hermes -p default gateway status`, and that gateway_state.json in the Hermes home reads as JSON with "
            f"active_agents); if the gateway is stopped, make sure no gateway process runs and gateway.pid is not stale "
            f"(why it was not accepted as stopped: {why}), then `python3 {SCRIPT} request` again.")
    desc = describe_work(work)
    log("evaluate", restart_wait_guidance(), loud=True)
    raise SwitchDeferred(
        "--switch-cmd was NOT run: someone is still working, and the checkout must not change under a running turn. "
        "STILL WORKING: " + " | ".join(desc or ["(unknown)"]) + ". State: nothing was switched and the gateway was NOT "
        "restarted; the drain marker is cleared so bots can work. Fix: wait for the bots above to finish "
        f"(`python3 {SCRIPT} status`), or ask them to checkpoint, then `request` again (give a longer --deadline-minutes "
        "if their turns are long). A busy deadline aborts the restart and releases the owned pause.")


def deadline_checkpoint(req, log):
    """Best-effort checkpoint comments, bounded independently of the number of working cards."""
    if req.get('deadline_checkpointed'):
        return
    req['deadline_checkpointed'] = True
    text = (f"CHECKPOINT NOW [{req['id']}]: the 10-minute gateway restart drain has ended. "
            "Write current progress, next step and half-edited files to Session-notes/. "
            "The gateway restarts now; Hermes marks running gateway turns resume_pending. "
            "External card workers are not killed by this tool.")
    log('deadline', 'WARNING: 10-minute drain ended; posting checkpoint notices and proceeding to restart', loud=True)
    try:
        work = who_is_working(collect_snapshot(False, lambda *a, **k: None))
        cards = sorted({it['task_id'] for items in work['by_profile'].values() for it in items if it.get('task_id')})
        atomic_write(NOTICE_FILE, json.dumps({'phase': 'coming', 'request': req['id'], 'text': text, 'deadline_at': req['deadline_at']}))
        from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
        def post(card):
            try:
                r = subprocess.run([hermes_bin(), 'kanban', 'comment', card, '--author', 'coordinated-restart', text],
                                   capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
                return card, 'commented' if r.returncode == 0 else f'WARNING: comment exit {r.returncode}'
            except Exception as e:
                return card, f'WARNING: checkpoint comment failed: {e}'
        results = {}
        if cards:
            with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(cards)) as pool:
                for card, result in pool.map(post, cards):
                    results[card] = result
                    log('checkpoint', f'card {card}: {result}', loud=result.startswith('WARNING'))
        update_request(req['id'], deadline_checkpointed_at=iso(), deadline_checkpoint_cards=cards,
                       deadline_checkpoint_results=results,
                       deadline_checkpoint_posted_cards=[card for card, result in results.items() if result == 'commented'])
    except Exception as e:
        log('checkpoint', f'WARNING: checkpoint notices unavailable: {e}; proceeding to restart', loud=True)


def confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log):
    try:
        confirm_idle_for_switch(log)
    except SwitchDeferred:
        if now() < req['deadline_at']:
            raise
        deadline_checkpoint(req, log)
        log('switch', 'WARNING: work remains or activity is unknown after deadline; owner authorizes restart continuation', loud=True)

send_notices(work, req, gs, key, log, dry)
            if dry:
                log("wait", f"would wait up to {req['deadline_minutes']} min for idle ({IDLE_CONFIRM_POLLS} quiet polls "
                            f"{POLL_SECONDS}s apart), refreshing the marker every {MARKER_REFRESH_SECONDS}s")
            else:
                # (e)
                update_request(rid, status="waiting")
                quiet, last_desc, last_refresh, last_say = 0, None, now(), 0.0
                while True:
                    check_cancel(rid)
                    pause.barrier(deadline_at)
                    pause.check()
                    snap = collect_snapshot(False, lambda *a, **k: None)
                    work = who_is_working(snap)
                    desc = describe_work(work)
                    update_request(rid, waiting_for=desc)
                    quiet = quiet + 1 if is_idle(work) else 0
                    earlier = earlier_stored_deadline(rid, deadline_at)  # a joiner may have shortened the stored deadline
                    if earlier < deadline_at:
                        log("wait", f"a joiner shortened the deadline: now {hhmm(earlier)} ({mins(earlier - now())} left)")
                        deadline_at = req["deadline_at"] = earlier
                    if quiet >= IDLE_CONFIRM_POLLS:
                        log("wait", "everyone is idle")
                        break
                    if desc != last_desc or now() - last_say > 60:
                        log("wait", f"{mins(deadline_at - now())} left; waiting for: " + " | ".join(desc or ["(nobody; confirming idle)"]))
                        last_desc, last_say = desc, now()
                    if now() >= deadline_at:
                        log("deadline", "DEADLINE PASSED" + (" with --switch-cmd" if switch_cmd else "") +
                            ": posting checkpoint notices and proceeding to restart", loud=True)
                        deadline_checkpoint(req, log)
                        confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log)
                        break
                    if owns_marker and now() - last_refresh > MARKER_REFRESH_SECONDS:
                        write_marker(principal)
                        last_refresh = now()
                    time.sleep(min(POLL_SECONDS, max(0.1, deadline_at - now())))  # wake at the deadline, not up to a poll after

        if dry:
            if switch_cmd:
                log("switch", f"would run --switch-cmd: {switch_cmd} (a non-zero exit would stop the restart)")
            log("restart", f"would run: {shlex.join([hermes_bin(), '-p', 'default', 'gateway', 'restart'])} "
                           f"(from {'a systemd/launchd job outside the gateway'})")
            log("drain", "would clear the drain marker right after the restart returns")
            log("verify", "would check: new gateway pid alive, /health answers, gateway_state running, every platform "
                          "connected, served_profiles complete, heartbeat fresh")
            log("resume", "would comment 'BACK ONLINE' on interrupted Kanban cards; Hermes itself resumes interrupted chat sessions")
            d_interrupted, d_cards = cut_sets(work)
            wake_bots(wake_profiles(d_interrupted, d_cards, notified), req, wake_cmd, log, True)
            log("outcome", f"would write {OUTCOME_FILE} and run the --notify-cmd route if one was given")
            return

        pause.barrier(deadline_at)
        pause.check()
        if not switch_cmd:
            confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log)  # Also required without --switch-cmd.

# (i) verify
        update_request(rid, status="verifying")
        ok, problems = verify(pre, log)
        log("verify", "gateway is back: new process, /health answering, platforms connected, heartbeat fresh" if ok
            else "PROBLEMS after restart: " + "; ".join(problems), loud=not ok)
        pause.release()
        log("pause", "owned Kanban pause released after health check")
        if not ok:
            raise Fail("Gateway health check failed: " + "; ".join(problems))
        resumes = resume_report(interrupted)
        for line in resumes:
            log("resume", line)

        # (j) tell interrupted bots
        text = back_online_text(req)
        atomic_write(NOTICE_FILE, json.dumps({"phase": "back", "request": rid, "text": text}))
        for p, tid in cards:
            log("resume", f"{p}: card {tid} -> {kanban_comment(tid, text)}")
        if interrupted:
            log("resume", "interrupted chat sessions are also resumed by Hermes itself (resume_pending); a bot that "
                          "checkpointed reads its Session-notes entry per the gateway-restart-checkpoint skill")
        wake_bots(wake_profiles(interrupted, cards, notified), req, wake_cmd, log, False)

        # (k) outcome
        status = "done" if ok and not stragglers else "done_with_warnings"
        outcome = (f"Restart {rid} finished {iso()}: gateway " + ("healthy." if ok else "NOT fully healthy: " +
                   "; ".join(problems) + f". Fix: hermes -p default gateway status; logs in {HERMES_HOME}/logs/.") +
                   (" Interrupted while working: " + " | ".join(stragglers) if stragglers else " Nobody was cut off."))
        update_request(rid, status=status, outcome=outcome, step="finished")
        atomic_write(OUTCOME_FILE, outcome + "\n")
        log("outcome", outcome, loud=not ok or bool(stragglers))
        if req.get("notify_cmd"):
            try:
                r = subprocess.run([*shlex.split(req["notify_cmd"]), outcome], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
                log("outcome", f"sent to requester via notify-cmd (exit {r.returncode})")
            except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError) as e:
                log("outcome", f"notify-cmd failed ({e}); the outcome is in {OUTCOME_FILE}", loud=True)
        else:
            log("outcome", f"no --notify-cmd route; requester reads it with `status` or {OUTCOME_FILE}")
    finally:
        # Always clear OUR marker, including on error/cancel/SIGTERM, so bots are never left unable to work.
        if owns_marker and not dry and cleanup_allowed(STATE_FILE, pause.owner) and clear_own_marker(principal):
            log("drain", "drain marker cleared (cleanup on exit)")

with locked(STATE_LOCK):
        st = load_state()
        r = st.get("request")
        if r and r.get('retain_pause') and not r.get('released_at') and (r['status'] not in ACTIVE or args.request_id != r['id']):
            os.close(fd)
            reject_unreleased_request(st)
        if args.request_id and (not r or r["id"] != args.request_id):
            raise Fail(f"request {args.request_id} is not in {STATE_FILE}. Fix: run `request --reason ...` again.")
        if not r or r["status"] not in ACTIVE:
            if not (args.reason or "").strip():
                raise Fail("no active request to run. State: nothing changed. Fix: `request --reason \"...\"`, or pass "
                           "--reason to `run` to start one by hand.")
            gap = min_gap_wait_seconds(now(), st.get("last_restart_at"), gateway_started_at(read_gateway_state()),
                                       args.min_gap_minutes * 60)
            r = st["request"] = new_request_record(args, who_am_i(args.by), gap)
        r["coordinator"] = {"pid": os.getpid(), "identity": process_identity(os.getpid()) if r.get("retain_pause") else None, "launcher": os.environ.get("GATEWAY_RESTART_LAUNCHER", "manual")}
        r.pop("launch_pending_until", None)  # we hold coordinator.lock now; if we die later the request is dead at once
        save_state(st)
    r["_coordinator_fd"] = fd  # in-memory only; never saved in state
    log = Log(r["id"], False)
    signal.signal(signal.SIGTERM, lambda *_: (_ for _ in ()).throw(Cancelled()))
    try:
        coordinate(r, args, log, False)

def coordinate_retained(req, log):
    rid = req['id']
    pause = DispatchPause(rid, log)
    try:
        if req.get('not_before') and req['not_before'] > now():
            update_request(rid, status='scheduled')
            sleep_checking(rid, req['not_before'] - now())
        req['deadline_minutes'], req['deadline_at'] = publish_initial_deadline(rid, req['deadline_minutes'])
        publish_retained_markers(req, pause)
        update_request(rid, status='draining')
        deadline = req['deadline_at']
        while True:
            pause.check()
            refresh_retained(rid)
            try:
                confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log)
                acquire_auxiliary(req)
                break
            except (SwitchDeferred, Fail) as e:
                if now() >= deadline:
                    deadline_checkpoint(req, log)
                    log('deadline', f'WARNING: drain/auxiliary check: {e}; restart proceeds', loud=True)
                    break
                time.sleep(min(POLL_SECONDS, max(.01, deadline - now())))
        check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        update_request(rid, status='restarting', switch_cmd=req.get('switch_cmd'))
        run_retained_callback(req, log)
        acquire_auxiliary_best_effort(req, log)
        pause.check()
        check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        confirm_idle_or_deadline(req, log)
        gs = read_gateway_state() or {}
        pre = {'pid': gateway_pid(gs), 'served': gs.get('served_profiles') or [],
               'platforms': [p for p, v in (gs.get('platforms') or {}).items() if v.get('state') == 'connected']}
        run_restart(log)
        update_request(rid, status='verifying')
        ok, problems = verify(pre, log)
        if not ok:
            raise Fail('Gateway health failed; pause retained: ' + '; '.join(problems))
        check_manifest(retained_record(rid))
        acquire_auxiliary_best_effort(req, log)
        update_request(rid, status='done', health_ok=True, outcome='Healthy. All pauses retained until explicit release.')
        atomic_write(OUTCOME_FILE, f'Restart {rid} finished {iso()}: gateway healthy. Exact-request pause release follows.\n')
    except BaseException:
        # A broken state file must remain untouched; its markers still fence launches.
        with contextlib.suppress(Fail, OSError):
            update_request(rid, status='failed', health_ok=False, outcome='Failed. All pauses retained for recovery.')
        raise
    finally:
        pause.release()  # closes handles before exact-request automatic release
        try:
            cmd_release(argparse.Namespace(request_id=rid, coordinator_fd=req.get("_coordinator_fd")))
        except Exception as e:
            log('release', f'WARNING: exact-request automatic release failed: {e}; run release --request-id {rid}', loud=True)

def _should_skip_external_secret_sources() -> bool:
    """True inside any ``hermes update`` process (and its import probes).

    Every dotenv load in the process — ``hermes_cli.main``, ``run_agent``, ``cli`` — consults
    this, so the updater never resolves external secret sources: on Windows they map
    ``cryptography._rust.pyd`` into the process replacing that venv, and everywhere a slow
    ``op``/``bws``/command helper (up to 120s per source) would run inside the updater's
    120s critical-module import probe and be reported as an import-health timeout.
    Profile flags are stripped before ``hermes_cli.main`` loads dotenv, so ``argv[1]`` is
    the authoritative subcommand.
    """
    return _UPDATE_RETRY_RECOVERED or sys.argv[1:2] == ["update"]
